name: Ukiyo-e Ink Print
description: A woodblock print brought to life: washi paper with long fibres, a Prussian-blue bokashi sky, a seigaiha wave band, a double key-block border and a vermilion seal. Titles are printed serif type beside a vertical red cartouche and underlined by a tapered sumi brush stroke; elements spread in like ink on wet paper, red hanko seals stamp verdicts, the camera pans like an unrolling handscroll and scenes are flooded by a sumi ink blot that thins into the next print. Calm, poetic and precise. No emoji. This is a format (look, camera, motion and layout), not a fixed subject: every video brings new subjects.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 contemplative scenes (4-6 s each). title.kicker is a short label shown in a vertical red cartouche (1-3 words); title.main a calm printed headline. visual.type "illustration" with 1-3 elements: icon (size l, shown inside a brush enso), timeline for sequences, card, compare, counter, stamp for a key verdict (a red seal). Leave space. Never use emoji. Draw new subjects every video: invent the icons, svg sketches and drawing elements for this topic, and never reuse the example spec's scenery, objects or wording.
